name: @w6w-apps/erpnext
description: Read and write ERPNext documents — any DocType — over Frappe's generic REST API, plus the submit/cancel document lifecycle.

w6w.longDescription:
ERPNext is an open-source, self-hosted ERP built on the Frappe framework, and Frappe does not expose per-business-object endpoints the way a SaaS CRM does — it exposes its own metadata layer, so every Customer, Sales Order, Item, Lead or Employee is a "DocType" reachable through one generic REST surface: `/api/resource/<doctype>`. This app wraps that surface rather than guessing at a fixed schema, because which DocTypes and fields exist depends entirely on which ERPNext modules and customizations a given install has turned on.

It covers the full document lifecycle any DocType shares: list with Frappe's own filter/field/sort/paging language, read one by name, create, update and delete. On top of that it adds ERPNext's submit/cancel workflow — the draft → submitted → cancelled state machine that Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Sales Invoices and most transactional DocTypes use to move from an editable draft to a posted, accounting-relevant document — plus a record count and a whitelisted remote-method escape hatch for business logic no generic CRUD call reaches.

Good for creating a Customer or Lead from an external form, submitting a Sales Order once a workflow's own approval step clears, keeping an Item catalog in sync with an outside pricing tool, or reaching any other DocType an installation exposes without waiting for a dedicated action to be written for it.
